data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bezalel total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

in_hebrew.name: Bezalel
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God is my rock
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Bezalel הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Hebrew, Bezalel means 'God is my rock'. This name is mentioned in the Old Testament Book of Exodus as the name of a skilled craftsman and artist whom God had filled with the Holy Spirit to create the Tabernacle and its furnishings.

in_greek.name: Bezalel
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God is my rock
in_greek.long_meaning: Bezalel είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. In Hebrew, Bezalel means 'God is my rock'. This name is mentioned in the Old Testament Book of Exodus as the name of a skilled craftsman and artist whom God had filled with the Holy Spirit to create the Tabernacle and its furnishings.

in_latin.name: Bezalel
in_latin.long_meaning: Bezalel, nomine significans creatorem, ab ebraico 'בצלאל' derivatum est, significans 'in Deo facere' vel 'facere in eo'. In libro Exodi, Bezalel designatus est ut architectus et artifex sacrorum tabernaculorum, ut ipse Deus per manum Moysi omnia ostendit. Bezalel, per suam creativitatem et artis perfectionem, exemplum fuit Christianorum creativitatis in Deum.
